instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Remove every noisy result one person ever gave the pool when they stop sharing", and give it contributor (The person's random contributor id).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:withdraw-pooled-results and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Runs in the account that holds the pool.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:pooled-result (records:list, records:write).
